name: ANSI wall lighting outlet plan symbol
summary: US plan symbol for a wall lighting outlet, a circle attached to the wall line by a short stem.
description: Wall-mounted lighting outlets, such as sconces and bracket lights, are drawn in US plans as a circle connected to the wall line by a short line. The fixture type letter is placed inside or beside it.

Height above floor is normally noted, as sconces are set to suit architectural features. The switch letter links it to its controlling switch. The symbol does not show the fixture size or the light distribution.
readingNotes: Note the stem to the wall.
distinction: The IEC wall luminaire uses a crossed circle on a bracket; the US form uses a plain circle on a stem.
